## What's Changed

- fix(settings): rebuild the settings page when its plugin and addon data changes (`930df321`)
- fix(skin): let hero, player and scrims bleed past the TV safe area (`940947e9`)
- fix(settings): hide the sidebar options on mobile (`77fe321a`)
- feat(settings): gate rows by desktop, mobile and tv (`49906172`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.14...v0.3.15
